body.statement: In the Yan--Wainwright four-block model, under their sub-block and noise conditions, Algorithm~1 has the master decomposition in their equations~\(6.1\)--\(6.2\): its missing-block estimation error equals the explicitly displayed sum of two linear noise terms and one bilinear noise term, plus a remainder bounded entrywise by \(C_4\sum_{j=1}^4 b_j(i,t)\) with probability at least \(1-O((N+T)^{-9})\).

attestation.note: Checked directly against the arXiv v2 source at the stated lemma and equations.
